description: Upload one App Store screenshot for a single iPhone display size from a master image that this tool auto-resizes. Pass screenshot_image_base64 or screenshot_image_url when the image bytes or a fetchable URL are available; use screenshot_display_types to pick exactly one display size per call, and call again for additional sizes.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

screenshot_display_type.description: Alias when passing one size via screenshot_display_type.

screenshot_display_types.description: Single type per call, e.g. APP_IPHONE_65 (default). Not comma-separated.

name: upload_screenshots
